title: Estimate temporal changes by aggregating normalized activity and infrastructure counts; compute yearly means and uncertainty
description: Compute global and EEZ mean time series of (1) daily average number of vessels and (2) monthly median number of infrastructure. Aggregate gridded normalized data over areas consistently sampled (e.g., Sentinel-1 2017–2021 coverage). From time series, compute yearly means and standard deviations. Estimate percent change over a specified event period (e.g., pandemic effect) and standard error by bootstrapping residuals relative to an average seasonal cycle. For visualization, optionally smooth time series with a rolling median.
